name: Courier
description: Provides storage for various types of messages.

suggests.drupal/token: Adds an improved token-selection UI to message edit forms.

project_description:
Back to top 

 Project discontinued 
 The spirit of Courier carries forward in Notifier , an implementation of Symfony Notifier for Drupal. 

 Courier is an API allowing modules to send messages to people via a channel of their preference.

 Back to top 

 Channels 
 
 
 
 Email 
 Bundled with Courier 
 
 
 Steam 
 Instant messaging via the Steam network. 
 
 
 Slack 
 Send to Slack channels or individual users. 
 
 
 SMS 
 SMS messaging via SMS Framework . 
 
 
 
 Back to top 

 Developers 
 
 Example: You can find an example of Courier in action with RNG module. 
 Documentation: Modules interested in compatibility with Courier should take a look at The Architecture of Courier
